units.source_text: 我實在難以理解那些彼此欺騙，卻又能通透明朗地活著，以及有信心活下去的人。

en.t: I simply could not understand people who deceived one another and yet lived with clear, bright openness, or who had the confidence to go on living.

units.source_text: 人類最終沒能讓我學會其中的奧妙。

en.t: Human beings never did teach me that secret in the end.

units.source_text: 如果我領會了這些奧妙，就不會如此畏懼人類，也不會拼命去討好他們，更用不著與人類的生活對立，夜夜飽受地獄般的痛楚折磨了吧。

en.t: If I had grasped those secrets, I would not have feared human beings so much, nor tried so desperately to please them, nor had to set myself against human life and suffer night after night under torments like hell.

units.source_text: 總之，我之所以沒有向任何人控訴男傭女傭造的孽，

en.t: In short, the reason I never accused the male and female servants of the evil they had done

units.source_text: 並不是出於我對人類的不信任，當然也不是因為基督教義，

en.t: was not that I distrusted human beings, and of course it was not because of Christian doctrine,

units.source_text: 而是因為人們對名叫葉藏的我緊閉上了信任的外殼。

en.t: but because people had closed the shell of trust tightly against me, the person called Yozo.

units.source_text: 就連我父母也時常向我展現他們令人費解的一面。

en.t: Even my parents would sometimes show me sides of themselves that I found impossible to understand.
